Ever since the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolled out to the majority of WhatsApp users on iOS, the messaging platform has been testing another visual change, this time focused on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

New chat bubbles look rounder

Months ago, WhatsApp finally began pushing out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly via TestFlight, after several months of testing and refinement.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be redesigned. The site now reports that the new bubble design is starting to roll out to some users running the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo had to say:

Beyond reshaping the message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, giving photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews a cleaner, more uniform look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is now available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight build. It remains unclear when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users.
